name: FedEx Ground Dallas Hub - Hutchins TX

fieldNotes.location: Confirmed FedEx Ground Dallas Hub at 1101 E Cleveland St, Hutchins TX — one of the largest FedEx Ground facilities, 720,000+ sq ft on a 102-acre site, processing 230,000+ packages/day with ~1,600 workers. Roster coordinate (GEOMETRIC_CENTER, moved 1.4 km) landed correctly on the hub. FedEx branding directly confirmed on the building face in 2026 Street View.
fieldNotes.buildingId: The FedEx hub is the distinctive solar-paneled-roof building at the center of the industrial campus; several neighboring large warehouses (different occupants) surround it, so care was taken to box only the FedEx property.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Site is fully enclosed by chain-link perimeter fencing with barbed-wire top (clearly confirmed in multiple 2026 Street View frames). Controlled private campus access. Counted as a controlled truck gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A guard booth could not be isolated in satellite — the truck gate sits deep inside the secured campus and Street View does not penetrate it. Marked true with medium confidence: a fenced FedEx Ground regional hub of this scale (one of the network's largest) is universally guard-staffed at the truck entrance. Flagged in uncertainFields.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: Likely 2 — a separate employee-vehicle entrance and a truck-yard entrance are typical at hubs this large; exact count is an estimate.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long private campus access roads and deep paved internal yard approaches — easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very large paved gate/yard aprons with abundant width for express bypass lanes.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Enormous hub: continuous dock banks with hundreds of trailers backed in along multiple building faces — far over 50, estimated ~280 total. Honest overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Vast trailer-parking fields wrap the building on the north, west and south — hundreds of drop trailers, clearly 50+. Estimated ~700 visible / ~850 capacity.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Within the Dallas metro industrial corridor (Hutchins/Wilmer logistics cluster), dense industrial fabric beside I-45 — classed Urban.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~103 acres from the perimeter box; documented site is 102 acres.
